node.title: Re: Perl substitute with the nth match
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I want a substitution with a Perlvar of the nth match, if one exists?

If I understand your question correctly, then no, no such [doc://perlvar] that keeps track of "how many" regexes have been executed/replaced exists, and you'll have to use one of the other methods you described. Update: Or the [id://11149536|clever hack] by [choroba].
